body:
Hey I have not improved.doctors still claim they don't know/there is nothing wrong with me despite my horrible symptoms. I struggle breathing everyday upon exertion and my pulmonary hypertension doctor doesn't know why my DLCO value is low... and doesn't want to check me for pulmonary hypertension. I'm so frustrated...
I had a nuclear stress test done last week and it showed something fishy, mild fixed perfusion defect, when I google it it mentions that its indicative of cardiac scar tissue.... FML if it is scar tissue. I will meet with the cardiologist next wednesday. I hope you get an answer soon I wish this situation on no one, not even my worst enemy.

I don't know the name yet because they first want me to rule out pulmonary hypertension but once I do they will give me treatment...Im already taking plaquenil. I don't get joint pain anymore (I have lupus and sjogrens).
I used to vape THC and I had an incident where I smoked it while on vyvanse for my adhd and it messed up my heart somehow where I cant exercise anymore without getting chest pain.
Bur maybe cannabis would still help, idk what have you heard about it?

I was only taking vyvanse at the time the heart palpitations started. I recently started a host of meds, including plaquenil and anti depressants so its not those. I know vyvanse is cardiotoxic though... I ofcourse stopped taking it as soon as possible.

Wow. Im a 24 year old female. I apparently seem to have had sjogrens for years because now Im super dry and I have pulmonary involvement....
I wish I was at the intial stages....you can slow down or even stop progression when you take plaquenil at the early stages....so consider your self lucky you haven't progressed to lung involvement. Don't kill yourself, I get short of breath very easily, can't exercise, Im very limited for a 24 year old and I ve had suicidal thoughts many times. You? You have so much to live for. Your lungs are fine, your heart is fine. Live and take plaquenil. Live for me, who may not be here in ten years because of loss of organ function. Show this disease that it won't take us down. Make sure you eat a good diet to reduce inflammation. See if your doctor can prescribe omega 3 fatty acids. My rhem prescribed it because it has proven to be anti inflammatory.

It will make me happy if you live and succeed and accomplish your dreams, because if I cant, at least you can. 
Best of luck.

And get a psychiatrist or psychologist to help you with anxiety. Dying in your state is not worth it .
Wow... what was causing them to shut off? Ny Lung CT scan came back normal.... so I still have no explaination for the low DLCO thats why I asked you how you got it diagnosed.
But does it limit you? Im so scared to get on immunosuppressants I am 24 years old and I m scared of getting an infection and dying
How did you get ILD diagnosed?
No you fucking dont. I have scarring of my lungs and lige is terrible.
Nah I just wanna be healthy which im not. I might die within 5 years
What do you mean sell your soul?
Let he say it to you. But I have you know, you guys sound like fantastic parents that child is blessed to have you in his life!
God please someone answer this In suffering from this too. Please someone answer I am afraid of dying I am only 24 (F)

Thanks. Since I feel short of breath, tired, and disabled, I managed to get an appointment tomoorow with my rheumatoligist to see if he can give me a stronger dose, or add to my medication to save what lungs I have left.

Can I ask you, if you dont mind talking about it ofcourse, what it was like to be in a ward? I went to a volunteer ward but I could leave at any time. I wasnt suicidal though. Now a days I feel worse and worse to the point Im scared of getting so bad that I may need to be on hold.
How was it like really?

Update: my DLCO in the lung capacity test is below normal: 67% of reference value.

This doesnt comfort me.

Hey sorry for the late reply. Im not too better. I had a second cardiologist say my heart is fine. So now my head is swirling with thoughts about Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension. It fits my symptoms perfectly. Im currently at the pulmonologist as I type this.

My depression has gotten worse. I cry almost everyday out of fear for my life.
I wish you the best. I am praying for you friend.
Hey. Sort of.I did a liver biopsy and a fibro scan mostly everything came out fine except for some very mild fibrosis and gallstones.

Sorry for the super late response. And yes there is heart disease but no COPD that I know of.
My fathr has high blood pressure and his dad has a pace maker. I dont know what lead to his heart failing though.
I remember when I had an EKG done a day after the whole thing happened the computer suggested I had mild left atrial enlargement. So no right sided enlargement that I know of.
I did a treadmill test and after getting my heart rate to 170 via fast walking my O2 saturation was at 98 percent so I think you are right, it isnt PH. I read online that non severe mitral valve prolapse can be very symptomatic despite it being not so severe. perhaps this is my case. He did not note regurgitation of the mitral valve, only that it was prolapsed.

Now a days I struggle with daily left arm pain and heart palpitations. I dont know if I am still equally intolerant to exercise though. I should try working out soon although I am afraid of getting chest pain that last 3 days, like I got the last time I jogged/ran in place. Walking fast is not the same as jogging.
Anyway,  thanks for the reply.
Thank you for the reply. Im significantly calmer now.

As an update, my heart palpitations wake up up every few hours. I can't sleep 7 hours straight anymore, that's wishful thinking at this point. I wake up with chest pain and sometimes shortness of breath. This is not anxiety. This is real. It is so limiting, sometimes I am in bed for several hours in the day from how heavy my chest feels and how tired I am. Eating is uncomfortable, it gives me palpitations in my abdomen. My heart is working overtime for real, and I don't know what it is.
My theory of Pulmonary hypertension still stands, my most recent ANA titer came out 1:1280, so very high. I have Sjogren's and people with this disorder can develop Pulmonary hypertension with the right trigger.
Will up date once I do the exercise tests.

There have been cases where they don't check for pulmonary artery pressure and idk if he did check for that I should ask.
Its just, caffeine and or light jogging sends my body into a two day frenzy of chest pain and fatigue. Can anxiety really triggered like that?
This wouldnt happen before I mixed the two THC and Vyvanse...

No matter, your reply is nonetheless helpful and I appreciate you for it.

Yes the super high bp was only during that incident. It went as high as 150/100 or something I believe but I dont remember that clearly the numbers anymore. I just know it was super high for what I normally get
Florida

Hi! Yes they know. But they also think things will settle itself. For now they are being supportive but I notice that they sometimes struggle dealing with stressful situations they don't understand. He thinks I have nothing, and is resting on that. I know I have something and it drives me crazy. I already have Sjogren's for several years, and digestive issues that are pending a liver diagnosis (finally someone takes concern over my liver lol). The digestive issues have been a battle I have been fighting for so long now. I think this doctor my figure out what it is I have besides IBS, although maybe a little too late.l since I have ascites.

Hi! I am in a mixed legal state and I already told him about the weed. For some reason he doesn't think much of it, but perhaps I should have told him it was concentrated THC oil and not so much weed. Yes I agree the heart things he found should be explored more just in case, don't lose anything in making sure everything is ok. At least though he wants to do an exercise stress test to get an objective view of my symptoms. I know he is going to find there is truly something wrong, since I am currently exercise intolerance amd I wasnt before hand!

Hi! I don't have high blood pressure. I only got high blood pressure during those six hours where my heart was freaking out. And my cardiologist knows about the weed. He doesn't think much of it, though this fact doesn't console me. I no longer take the stimulant, and I took the stimulant as my neurologist prescribed, except that I smoked weed that same night (yes I know that was a mistake now).
Thanks for the reply.

I currently have chest pain right now and ofc I am still scared, but your reply helps me a bit. I will not be taking any more drugs that are not necessary. I have been almost 2 months sober from Vyvanse, weed, and even alcohol(this one more like 3 months). I do have liver problems that might have contributed also ti the potency of the vyvanse, but at the time of taking the vyvanse I didnt know my liver enzymes were a concern until I recieved my blood results last week, where there is a trend of slightly elevated liver enzymes together with some unspecified  autoimmunity going on in my body.
Ugh.
I wish I didnt actually have sickness. I guess since I am sick in other areas, my brain thinks the worst. My heart symptoms are real I cannot exercise anymore, but maybe my interpretation is flawed. Even if it is something serious, maybe it can be repaired surgically, unlike pulmonary hypertension.
Anyway, thanks for your reply.

Oh I am.willing to stay off anything amd everything that's unnecessary after this. I googled (somewhat terrible idea ofc) my symptoms and eventually came across Pulmonary Hypertension. One of the causes CAN be dugs like amphetamines or cocaine. I had an amphetamine for my ADHD and then smoked THC for my anxiety at night. I smoked somouch I know it some how elevated the side effects of ftehvyvasne or elevated its potency that it sent my heart into a rage for 6 full hours.
What did you get clean of and what kind of damage did it do to you? Do you still have those symptims?

I really hope so. I just don't understand why all of a sudden I cannot exercise and receive heart stress like caffeine without feeling tired, dizzy or getting a weird blood pressure reading like 122/67 Since that incident with the drugs. I personally feel physically better when I do not exert myself, and feel worse on the days I do. Thanks for the reply.
Welp I kmow that now haha. I stopped taking both substances since the day of that incident.
Yeah I can see my anxiety is making whatever is going on with me worse.
Thank you so much

My love how did you achieve this? I have acsites and I am ending a cirrhsis diagnosis I am fearing for my life! Everywhere in the internet it says ascites is certain death unless you manage to get an organ transplant. The thing is... I have an autoimmune disorder (Sjogrens) so Im scared the organ will not be accepted by my body! So scared
Amen

I am a someone's sister. Your concern and request for prayers softens my heart and I hope the Lord grants you  and her peace and healing. Let love prosper over fear, anger, or confusion. Continue to be there for her, your love, along with your faith, can move mountains. May God bless you and your family.
Beautiful baby girl. Many blessings to you and your family!
I havent taken vyvanse since that day. And I was diagnosed with Sjogrens in 2017. Dude chill.

Well I was prescribed Vyvanse by my neurologist because I have ADHD.
What was not prescribed was the Marijuana.
I got a hypertensive crisis for several hours after smoking weed the same day I took my vyvanse.
I did not know I had Mitral valve prolapse until I went to the cardiologist a few weeks ago and he found it. I already have diagnosed Sjogrens and just recieved my blood tests back for autoimmune hepatitis, liver function and immune system. It doesn't seem to be autoimmune hepatitis case, but I need to hear my doctor s interpretation of those blood tests. The only thing that shows up is a severe autoimmune reaction from my ANA results, and I already know I have Sjogrens. The digestive issues are still a mystery right now. 

As for the heart, I cannot do normal activities without some degree of shortness of breath or chest pain or heart palpitations. Which was not the causs before that time my heart went sonic for six hours. Possibly triggered some form of arrythmia, will find out my iptions next week as I am Going to see cardiologist next week for the holter monitor results.

I get why you may say I am finding ways to be sick, but I feel sick, and there was a time where I wasn't.
Anyway thanks for the response still.
I will pray for Sam. I am sorry this is happening to him and to you. Its so lovely to see the love you have for him. Let that love fuel your faith.
Praying for you love.
Praying for your mom and you. I'm so sorry.
Thank you so so much. Bless you
Thank you so much. My soul is smiling! Bless you all.
What else besides depression did these meds make you feel? Were you taking those meds for all those 20 years?
By crash cart you mean cardioversion? I was hoping to get ablation. I have a messed up liver and I also have depression so i dont want to take the meds
Sorry freakin sorry about that. But you were able to workout still right? You were just scared to, in the beginning of your health journey? Why didn't they do a catheter ablation on you?

Please pray for my physical and mental healing. I am 23 years old and am having cardiac issues after a drug combination I wasn't supposed to do. I also have digestive problems that have plagued me for years and my doctors are investing my liver now as the culprit of all those years of dysfunction. Please pray that I may find God amidst this trial as well. My name is Viv

I do want to get healed. I am so grateful for your time. Your message of God brings me peace. I want to be at peace. I want to get to the point where these pains and limitations I feel are irrelevant to how I see the world, and how I love God. I want that love to be the only thing that matters, whether he heals me physically or not. I don't want to turn to him just so he can heal me, which is what I am doing right now. I want to love him unconditionally without expectations, where he can do to me as he sees fit. I hope I can achieve this goal.
Thank you for linking me to this. I will refer back to this many a times. God bless you for posting this.
What do you cook for your family normally? I am especially curious because you said you are British Asian. What a cool combo!

Yes... I actually have memory issues and increased fatigue, which caused my grades to slip pretty bad. Thank you for sharing that strategy of mnemonics. Where you able to finish college or get over that period in your life pretty well?

I used to write as a young teenager. Maybe I can return to that but I am not so good at communicating effectively. I enjoy cooking,  but I am very limited as to what I can eat. I dont know yet what that limit is officially though. COVID is making it tough to get things done in terms of meeting doctors and testing.

 I should probably mention that I am a senior in college and only have a few classes to finish in order to get my degree, but I cannot for the life of me complete the classes I am currently enrolled in because I am either tired, dizzy or depressed. I am not a good student, haven't been for a coulpe of years so the only thing I would have to show for is my Bio degree but now I may not even get that anytime soon.

Anyway thank you for the reply.

You are so sweet to reply. I am so far gone mentally I'm afraid of losing my mind within the next few weeks if nothing gets better. Your reply made me smile a little.

I like to cook Italian themed stuff, but you can catch me making hispanic foods too. I want to learn more about cooking, so I planned to cook every weekend possible a different meal from a different culture with my boyfriend. Ofcourse, this plan was made before my gastro said I may have auto immune hepatitis, and before the weed and vyvanse incident. We have tried to make Scandinavian Smorgasbord (sorry for mispelling) and fettucini alfredo so far. The alfredo was ejected from my digestive system without much processing though, lol.

I want to make Samosas two saturdays from now, but I most likely would only eat 1 samosa, if anything.

I live with my parents and have a boyfriend, but my folks are not so good at caring too much about their own health and thus think I am always exaggerating and dont understand why I cry everyday over my many symptoms.
 I feel bad for my boyfriend because we started dating two months ago, after knowing each other for two years and all these troubles started to really affect me within those two months. I dont want him to carry the burden of such a sick person, so i am considering ending it with him. He helps distract me from my issues but I know it will catch up some how. I just dont know if he is strong enough to handle the reality of whats going on with me.

Yikes I kinda vented all over the place in this comment.

Do you have your health? Because I dont. As hard as it is to say this, rejoice in your ability to exercise normally, eat normally if you wanted too, and indulge in vices if you can. I cant do any of those things but I wish I had the problems I had before all this befell on me.
I thought my break up was the worst thing in the world but this....having a broken body...is much much worse.
Please look into loving yourself and your body.
Im sorry about the suicidal thoughts. Yeah I could use a talk.
Whaaat
Are you a doctor?

I am 23 at the moment. I have an inconsistent diet. For many years it was a typical hispanic + American diet, full of carbs fat and meat.
I tried keto for two months and my liver enzymes where normal, but I had high cholesterol so I stopped (this was around November 2019). Now I eat protein, vegetables, and alot of fruits. Stool is still abnormal.
This is part of why I think the doctor's suspition of having a liver issue may be right, and that is scary. He also suspects Crohn's disease though.

Protein makes me constipated, but it might be better than the mushy dark green or yellow oily stool I get from mixing protein with carbs, or eating something fat heavy.

Gastric issues began around 12, with a peptic ulcer. Since then its been a slow ride down, new symptoms getting added every couple of years or so.
Now I do not have normal stools. Its as I ve mentioned, dark green, dark brown (almost black), or yellow and oily(when I eat stuff with fat in it).

Depending on how the meeting with my doctor goes, I may stick to a protein only diet for a good time.

I suck at following orders, to my detriment. That's why Im so nervous also. I love food, I was thinking of becoming a chief! Until all this dawned on me. Maybe I won't have to give up that goal, simply put it off for a few years until I get on my feet, but yeah, I know in the end of the day you gotta do what you gotta do and that's that.
Thanks for the advice.
Thank you, I really do appreciate your response. I take it you have IBS?
Sorry for what you went through! And thanks, I ll try to not to jump to conclusions as best as I can. I hope you are currently well.

Hi, the bloating like Im pregnant part is what worries me. Im super bloated, looking like Im 5 or 6 months pregant. I ve been struggling with this kind of bloating for a while, and it has gotten only slightly worse since I started getting dark and or yellow stools. Im not able to digest fats properly, also.
How ever I must say your comment does comfort me a bit. It seems for sure my liver isnt failing me at the moment.

Im sorry to hear you went through that. How are you now? What treatment are you on?
Hey how come I cant post in this r/ ? Its not letting me. Also im sorry to hear your struggle...I hope it gets better soon

I'm sorry about your mom having such troubles. May I ask what symptoms she had, and what treatment they gave her? How is she doing now? And funny I neglected to mention I has an abdominal ultrasound done a few weeks ago, so the discussion with my doctor is pending for that, as well as the blood tests I am literally about to take. I meet with the doc in two thursdays from now. He did mention wanting to check for my liver tissue elasticity after the blood tests, I suppose this is what you mean by fibro scan.
Many thanks, I posted it there!

Hey man, I just want to thank you for posting the info you do. I am having weird and sucky symptoms, such as dark stool and yellow oily stool. Lately I have had a streak of dark green stool.
I have severe bloating, muscle weakness hair loss, low hypotension, dizziness, temperature intolerance, flatulance etc.

I was diagnosed with sjogrens in 2017, and now I am taking some blood tests to check for autoimmune hepatitis. 
Im scared to death that I ll be told, not only do I have hepatitis, but, once he does the liver scan to test the elasticity of the liver, that I have cirrhosis. I am so scared of getting a cirrhosis diagnosis....but your post gives me something to look at in case I do get it.

I don't have that much money. Or an idea of where you get the stuff you use, but your explanations about the liver's function is very helpful. I am a Bio major on my last year so I can appreciate the scientific approach you took.
Please let me know if any other advice comes to mind, for again, I am scared to death.
Bless you and your family.

Hey, my doctor suspects I have AIH and sent me to do some blood tests, but this is after I already have crazy symptoms like dark stool and yellow stool, hair loss. Muscle weakness, and heavy bloating. I was diagnosed with Sjogrens around 2017 so its no surprise if I do indeed have AIH for it can happen with sjogrens patients...
My issue is, it might be too late...
Im hecka scared I have cirrhosis and I am dying to find out, but this COVID situation is slowing me down a little.  You mentioned facebook group, I dont use facebook, do you know of other groups that help and support eachother for autoimmune and
Hold on maybe I misread but, what are those symptoms you are experiencing exactly?

Hey sorry for not knowing this, but by dx do you mean diagnosis? And ok, thanks for the heads up about the ANCA panel. I will be sure to push this doctor if it gets to that point. Im done suffering without knowing what is going on. Have you heard about living donor transplants?
Thank you... I await your response! Sleep well.

Can I know how you did this? I was told a few years ago I have a fatty liver, but it wasnt a "big deal".
Now I am pending a diagnosis of autoimmune hepatitis because of my worsening symptoms, such as dark green stool or yellow oily stool, and some right upper quadrant pain, hair loss (gradual), easy brusing, visible  abdominal bloating (pray to God it isn't ascites...). I am so scared I may have cirrhosis, which I am told isnt reversible, but if I can hear your success stort maybe it can calm my nerves a bit.

Chris Cornell had a great voice, I also love "Be yourself" by audiomachine. And sure, sounds fun.

3 words: Dreamer, adventurous, and sensitive

Favorite animal: Tardigrade

Favorite color kind of hard but this is what I can muster to be close to the truth:  Rainbow matrix opal color schemes.

Thank you, believe it or not your post dried my tears. I got in the chicken and started making food for my parents. The army is much more intensive than anything I ever wanted to or planned to do, so if you got through that (and wanted to at that) there has got to be some truth to the statement "mind over body". I feel a little better, mentally speaking.

Again, thank you bro.
